profile.headline: Java Full Stack  Engineer  at Wells Fargo
profile.geoLocationName: Roselle Park, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Java Full Stack
positions.locationName: Edison, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
·        Design and develop scalable, high-performance full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Framework for backend services and Angular for responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces.
  
·        Build and maintain microservices-based architecture, ensuring secure, loosely coupled, and reusable services across enterprise applications.
  
·        Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate them seamlessly with Angular frontends, ensuring efficient data flow and optimal user experience.
  
·        Implement modern Angular features (components, services, RxJS, state management) to create dynamic and interactive UI applications.
  
·        Integrate GenAI capabilities (such as LLM-based services, AI-powered chatbots, and automated code/test generation) into applications to enhance functionality and developer productivity.
  
·        Utilize tools like GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development frameworks to accelerate coding, debugging, and testing processes.
  
·        Work with messaging systems like Kafka for real-time data streaming and event-driven architecture.
  
·        Design and manage databases including relational (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), ensuring data integrity and performance optimization.
  
·        Implement search and indexing solutions using Elasticsearch for efficient data retrieval and analytics.
  
·        Develop and integrate payment processing systems, including handling standards like SWIFT and ISO 20022 messaging formats.
  
·        Apply caching strategies using technologies like Redis to improve system performance and scalability.
  
·        Deploy and manage applications in cloud environments (Azure, GCP, PCF, OpenShift), ensuring high availability and resilience.
  
·        Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, and SonarQube to automate build, test, and deployment processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Oracle Certification Program (OCP) · Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) · Spring Boot · Hibernate · Project Management · React.js · HTML · CSS3 · JavaScript

positions.title: Java Full Stack  Engineer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
·        Work on building and enhancing full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular, delivering end-to-end features.
  
·        Develop dynamic, responsive UI components using Angular (10+), TypeScript, RxJS, and Angular Material, ensuring seamless integration with backend services.
  
·        Design and develop RESTful APIs that are secure, scalable, and easy to maintain, and containerize applications using Docker for consistent deployment across environments.
  
·        Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions with clean and efficient code.
  
·        Follow Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and write unit and integration tests to ensure high code quality and reliability.
  
·        Use tools like Maven/Gradle for build automation, Git for version control, and CI/CD pipelines (such as GitLab CI) to streamline development and deployment processes.
  
·        Work with cloud and container platforms like OpenShift and AWS to deploy, monitor, and manage applications in a distributed environment.
  
·        Develop and maintain event-driven systems using Apache Kafka, handling real-time data streaming and building reliable data pipelines.
  
·        Handle batch processing and data integration tasks, including working with large datasets and supporting data pipelines in systems like Snowflake.
  
·        Participate in system design discussions and contribute to designing scalable, high-performance, and secure architectures.
  
·        Troubleshoot and resolve production issues by analyzing logs, identifying root causes, and implementing fixes in a timely manner.
  
·        Support workflow and integration processes, including working with BPM tools and integrating third-party services like DocuSign when required.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·        Collaborated with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements across retail banking, mortgage lending, commercial finance, wealth management, and risk/compliance systems.
  
·        Designed cloud-native application architecture using Java microservices on AWS, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability for banking workloads.
  
·        Developed backend services for customer accounts, loan processing, payments, mortgage workflows, and business banking operations using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs.
  
·        Built and deployed applications on AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) with proper environment segregation for development, testing, and production.
  
·        Implemented secure data storage and transaction processing using AWS RDS/DynamoDB, ensuring data consistency and regulatory compliance.
  
·        Integrated services for risk assessment, compliance checks, fraud monitoring, and audit logging to meet banking and regulatory standards.
  
·        Supported mortgage and commercial lending modules including loan origination, approvals, documentation, and repayment tracking.
  
·        Implemented authentication, authorization, and encryption mechanisms using Spring Security, IAM roles, and AWS security best practices.
  
·        Performed unit, integration, and cloud environment testing using JUnit, Mockito, and monitored applications using AWS CloudWatch.
  
·        Supported CI/CD pipelines, deployments, production monitoring, and issue resolution while following SDLC and Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Math tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutor students part-time in Math subject which include: Linear Algebra, Calculus 1, Calculus 2, Abstract Algebra, Pre-Calculus, Introduction to Proofs and College Algebra 
•	Helped struggling students improve their critical thinking and problem solving skills

positions.title: Cyber Security analyst
positions.description:
•	Threat analysis and incident reporting, and bringing together analysist in order to promote statewide awareness of local cyber threats
•	Conducted experience working with Kibana which is visualization website. It collects the data and transforms it into the visualization graph such as bar and pie chart.
•	Able to learn about the DHS cybersecurity mission by completing hands-on cybersecurity 
•	Building technical experience in key areas such as digital forensics, network diagnostics and incident response.
•	Decode code from the Kibana and converted to the regular expression(Regex) order to readable for Kibana software.

positions.title: Summer Reaerch expereice
positions.description:
♣	Examine the Electrical Excitation, Calcium Signaling, and Mechanical Contraction Cycle of a Heart Cell
♣	Extend a previous PDE model to incorporate the mechanical component of the Calcium Induced Calcium release cycle in C and Matlab
♣	Worked closely with graduate student mentor, faculty mentor, Matthias Gobbet UMBC Department of Mathematics and Statistics, and client Zana Coulibaly, UC Davis Department of Pharmacology to solve the complex math equation that formulated for our research. 
♣	URL: http://hpcreu.umbc.edu/2017-2/summer-2017-projects/team-5-coupling-the-electrical-and-calcium-dynamics-in-a-heart-cell/
